name: Exp_Ozymandias
summary: This EA trades based on the Ozymandias custom indicator, which signals trend direction changes via buffer values of 0 and 1. It opens buy positions when the indicator switches from 0 to 1 and sell positions when it switches from 1 to 0, with configurable stop loss and take profit. Position management is delegated to the TradeAlgorithms library for both opening and closing trades.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Ozymandias自定义指标进行交易，该指标通过缓冲区值0和1来发出趋势方向变化信号。当指标从0变为1时开多仓，从1变为0时开空仓，并可配置止损和止盈。仓位管理委托给TradeAlgorithms库来执行开仓和平仓操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于Ozymandias指标的趋势跟踪，该指标通过平滑移动平均和价格通道计算来识别趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区值从0变为1时开多仓，表示上升趋势确立；当指标缓冲区值从1变为0时开空仓，表示下降趋势确立。出场条件包括：反向信号触发时平仓（多仓在指标变为0时平仓，空仓在指标变为1时平仓），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用MM参数控制仓位大小，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式两种资金管理方式。EA仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了执行效率。然而，策略缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，止盈止损为固定点数而非基于ATR等动态指标，在波动性变化大的市场中可能不够灵活。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Ozymandias indicator, which identifies trend direction through smoothed moving averages and price channel calculations. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the indicator buffer switches from 0 to 1, signaling an uptrend establishment; a sell position opens when the buffer switches from 1 to 0, signaling a downtrend establishment. Exit conditions include: closing on reverse signal (longs close when indicator becomes 0, shorts close when indicator becomes 1), plus fixed-pip stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting both lot-based mode and margin-based percentage mode for money management. The EA only calculates signals on new bar formation rather than every tick, which improves execution efficiency by avoiding redundant recalculations. However, the strategy lacks position scaling logic (no add-to or reduce-from existing positions), and the stop loss/take profit are fixed pip values rather than dynamically calculated using ATR or similar volatility-based indicators, which may be inflexible in markets with varying volatility conditions.

parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling margin per trade

parameters.name: MMMode

parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode: LOT (fixed) or FREEMARGIN (margin ratio)

parameters.name: SellPosOpen

parameters.description_en: Allow opening short position on bearish signal

parameters.description_en: Allow closing long position on reverse signal

parameters.description_en: Allow closing short position on reverse signal

parameters.description_en: Moving average type used by Ozymandias indicator

parameters.description_en: Trend bar index for signal judgment

pros: 使用新K线检测机制，避免逐tick重复计算信号，执行效率高
提供完整的买卖开关控制，可灵活配置只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓
包含止损和止盈保护，有基本的风险控制措施
信号计算失败时有Recount重试机制，增强了鲁棒性
使用自定义指标分离策略逻辑，模块化设计便于维护
pros_en: Uses new bar detection mechanism to avoid recalculating signals on every tick, ensuring high execution efficiency
Provides complete buy/sell toggle controls, allowing flexible configuration such as open-only or close-only modes
Includes stop loss and take profit protection with basic risk control measures
Implements a Recount retry mechanism on signal calculation failure, enhancing robustness
Separates strategy logic into a custom indicator for modular design and easier maintenance
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未根据市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整，在高波动市场可能过小或低波动市场过大
缺乏加仓减仓逻辑，无法在趋势延续时增加仓位以放大盈利
未检查是否已有同方向持仓，可能导致重复开仓
Ozymandias指标为自定义外部指标，依赖性高且指标逻辑不透明，无法独立回测验证
没有包含点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在不合适的时段可能产生不利成交
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are fixed pip values without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (e.g., ATR), potentially too tight in volatile markets or too wide in calm markets
Lacks position scaling logic, unable to add to winning positions during trend continuation to maximize profits
Does not check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially causing duplicate entries
The Ozymandias indicator is a custom external dependency with opaque logic, making independent backtesting and verification impossible
No spread filter or trading session filter included, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during inappropriate hours
improvements: 将固定止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态止损止盈，以适应不同市场波动环境
增加同方向持仓检查逻辑，避免重复开仓导致过度暴露风险
improvements_en: Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic levels to adapt to varying market volatility conditions
Add same-direction position checking logic to prevent duplicate entries and avoid excessive risk exposure

risk_points: 未检查同方向已有持仓，可能重复开仓导致风险敞口超出预期
固定止损止盈无法适应市场波动变化，可能在高波动时止损过小导致频繁被止损
依赖外部自定义指标，指标不可用或更新时EA将完全失效
risk_points_en: No check for existing same-direction positions, potentially causing duplicate entries that exceed intended risk exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit cannot adapt to market volatility changes, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high volatility
Depends on external custom indicator; EA becomes completely non-functional if the indicator is unavailable or updated
